title: Reflector Candidates Delta
$comment: NOT a pipeline stage gate. core/gates/validator.js and the stage-*.schema.json files next door validate pipeline/gates/*.json written by dispatched build/review workstreams and are read by every host adapter's gate footer. This schema instead describes the one-shot advisory output of the opt-in Reflector pass (plans/phase-30-closed-learning-loop.md item 30.3, ACE arXiv:2510.04618) — it never becomes a gate, is read once by core/learning/reflector.js, and is discarded whole if invalid. It lives under gates/schemas/ for the same tooling conventions (draft 2020-12, urn:stagecraft:schema:* $id, contract.test.js's generic schema-shape checks) but in its own learning/ subdirectory so the stage↔schema 1:1 sweep in contract.test.js and scripts/consistency.js (which only look at *.schema.json files directly under gates/schemas/) doesn't need to special-case a schema with no matching stage.
description: Validated by core/learning/validate-candidates-delta.js (hand-written checks, matching this repo's existing convention of not depending on a JSON Schema validator library). Malformed or non-conforming output is discarded in full — never partially applied.

schema_version.description: Schema version this payload conforms to.

new_candidates.description: New pattern-candidate proposals. Landed into the same observations store gate-derived candidates come from (core/patterns.js ingestReflectorCandidates), tagged source: "reflector". Promotion is still the existing human `devteam patterns promote` flow — nothing here is auto-promoted.

tier.description: Same tier vocabulary as promoted patterns (core/patterns.js DEFAULT_BUDGET). "positive" is the ACE-lite addition — a reinforcement of something the run got right, not just a failure signal.

signal.description: Short slug-able identifier for what was observed — feeds the same detector-derivation core/patterns.js uses for gate-derived observations (detectorFrom).

summary.description: What happened and why it matters. Feeds domain inference (core/patterns.js domainFrom) the same way a gate blocker's description does.

workstream.description: Optional. Role this observation concerns, e.g. "backend". Absent means unscoped.

stage.description: Optional. Stage id this observation concerns, e.g. "stage-04".

counter_adjustments.description: Suggested corrections to a promoted pattern's stats counters, when run evidence contradicts them. Advisory only — logged for audit (run-log.jsonl outcome: reflector-proposal), not auto-applied. An operator can act on the suggestion via `devteam patterns demote`/`promote` as today.

pattern_id.description: id of an entry in the currently-promoted set (embedded in the dispatch prompt).

field.description: Which stats counter this suggestion concerns (core/patterns.js stats shape).

reason.description: Why the run's evidence suggests this counter is wrong.

dedup_merges.description: Suggested merges of two or more promoted patterns that describe the same underlying behavior. Advisory only, same audit-not-applied treatment as counter_adjustments.

keep_id.description: id of the promoted pattern to keep.

merge_ids.description: ids of promoted pattern(s) proposed to fold into keep_id.

reason.description: Why these describe the same underlying behavior.
